correctness.rationale: The Herschel graph is explicitly reconstructed from three core vertices, two poles and six degree-three pair/pole vertices (18 edges); bipartition 5+6 forces path endpoints into degree-three part, with exactly two unused edges at each endpoint. The code enumerates all spanning simple paths via canonical reversal, generates precisely the stated Pósa endpoint rotations and performs BFS from all 222 paths. An independently implemented DFS plus backbite BFS regenerated 222 paths, 444 undirected edges, 4-regularity, connectivity, exact histogram (444,1152,2436,4326,6348,6189,3078,546,12), eccentricity multiplicities 198 at 8 and 24 at 9, and 12 disjoint diameter-9 pairs. Exhaustion is finite and exact rather than a timeout or sample.
